d:
Thirty men from Jammu and Kashmir's Reasi district, who went missing between 1991 and 2003, are allegedly operating from Pakistan and working to revive terrorism in the region, according to DGP Nalin Prabhat. Police say they are linked to Hizbul Mujahideen and are accused of supplying arms, ammunition and money, as well as radicalising local youth. Reasi Police have identified five terror handlers and attached 29 kanals of land belonging to them.
Thank you for watching our video!
